acceptance: OEM confirmation of fuel range and H2 capability
text: Reference composition (mol %): CH4 93.0, C2H6 3.5, C3H8 0.8, C4+ 0.3, N2 1.6, CO2 0.8; LHV 48.4 MJ/kg. The plant shall accept the full network range: LHV 45.0 MJ/kg to 50.0 MJ/kg, Wobbe index 47 MJ/Nm3 to 52 MJ/Nm3, H2S below 5 mg/Nm3, and hydrogen admixture up to 10 vol %.
title: Fuel gas specification
